name: sql-connector-mcp
description: Enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for multi-database querying (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB, MS Access, MySQL) with zero-tolerance safety guardrails preventing DROP TABLE, unbounded DELETE/UPDATE, and destructive operations.

scripts.test: node --experimental-sqlite --experimental-strip-types tests/guardrails.test.ts && node --experimental-sqlite --experimental-strip-types tests/sqlite-adapter.test.ts && node --experimental-sqlite --experimental-strip-types tests/mcp-server.test.ts
